segments.mn103:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā pisinārāyaṃ [kusinārāyaṃ (sī.)] viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
segments.mn103:2.2: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, itibhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’”ti?
segments.mn103:2.3: “Na kho no, bhante, bhagavati evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn103:2.4: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, piṇḍapātahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, senāsanahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti, itibhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’”ti.
segments.mn103:2.5: “Na ca kira vo, bhikkhave, mayi evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn103:2.6: ‘cīvarahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti … pe …
segments.mn103:2.7: itibhavābhavahetu vā samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’ti;
segments.mn103:2.8: atha kinti carahi vo [atha kinti vo (sī. pī.), atha kiñcarahi vo (ka.)], bhikkhave, mayi hotī”ti?
segments.mn103:2.12: “Evañca [evaṃ (sī. pī.)] kira vo, bhikkhave, mayi hoti –
segments.mn103:3.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, ye vo [ye te (ka.)] mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.mn103:3.2: cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, tattha sabbeheva samaggehi sammodamānehi avivadamānehi sikkhitabbaṃ.
segments.mn103:4.1: Tesañca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyaṃsu [siyuṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.) saddanīti oloketabbā] dve bhikkhū abhidhamme nānāvādā.
segments.mn103:5.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānan’ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ [subbacataraṃ (ka.)] maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:5.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:5.5: yathā atthato ceva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:5.7: Athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:5.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:5.10: yathā atthato ceva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:5.12: Iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
segments.mn103:5.13: Duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā [iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) anantaravārattaye pana idaṃ pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi] yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
segments.mn103:6.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sametī’ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:6.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
segments.mn103:6.5: yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
segments.mn103:6.7: Athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:6.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
segments.mn103:6.10: yathā atthato hi kho nānaṃ, byañjanato sameti.
segments.mn103:6.12: Iti duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
segments.mn103:6.13: Duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
segments.mn103:7.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato hi kho sameti, byañjanato nānan’ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:7.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:7.5: yathā atthato hi kho sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:7.8: Athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:7.9: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato hi sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:7.11: yathā atthato hi kho sameti, byañjanato nānaṃ.
segments.mn103:7.14: Iti suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretabbaṃ, duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretabbaṃ.
segments.mn103:7.15: Suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā duggahitaṃ duggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
segments.mn103:8.2: ‘imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato ceva sameti byañjanato ca sametī’ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:8.3: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva sameti, byañjanato ca sameti.
segments.mn103:8.5: yathā atthato ceva sameti byañjanato ca sameti.
segments.mn103:8.7: Athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:8.8: ‘āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato ceva sameti byañjanato ca sameti.
segments.mn103:8.10: yathā atthato ceva sameti byañjanato ca sameti.
segments.mn103:8.13: Suggahitaṃ suggahitato dhāretvā yo dhammo yo vinayo so bhāsitabbo.
segments.mn103:9.1: “Tesañca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyā aññatarassa bhikkhuno āpatti siyā vītikkamo,
segments.mn103:10.1: tatra, bhikkhave, na codanāya taritabbaṃ [coditabbaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.) turitabbaṃ (?)]. Puggalo upaparikkhitabbo –
segments.mn103:10.2: ‘iti mayhañca avihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto, paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adaḷhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun’ti.
segments.mn103:11.2: ‘mayhaṃ kho avihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto, paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī adaḷhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
segments.mn103:11.3: Appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ yadidaṃ – parassa [yadidaṃ mayhañca vihesā bhavissati parassa ca (ka.)] puggalassa upaghāto.
segments.mn103:11.5: svāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun’ti.
segments.mn103:12.2: ‘mayhaṃ kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto. Paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī daḷhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
segments.mn103:12.3: Appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ yadidaṃ – mayhaṃ vihesā [mayhañca vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto (ka.)].
segments.mn103:12.5: svāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun’ti.
segments.mn103:13.2: ‘mayhañca kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto. Paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī daḷhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi cāhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetuṃ.
segments.mn103:13.3: Appamattakaṃ kho panetaṃ yadidaṃ – mayhañca vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto.
segments.mn103:13.5: svāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun’ti.
segments.mn103:14.2: ‘mayhañca kho vihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa upaghāto. Paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī daḷhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, na cāhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun’ti.
segments.mn103:15.1: “Tesañca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃhāro [vacīsaṅkhāro (sī. pī.)] uppajjeyya diṭṭhipaḷāso [diṭṭhipalāso (sī. ka.)] cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.
segments.mn103:15.2: Tattha ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:15.3: ‘yaṃ no, āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppanno diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi, taṃ jānamāno samaṇo garaheyyā’ti [samāno (sī. ka.)].
segments.mn103:15.4: Sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn103:15.5: ‘yaṃ no, āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppanno diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi, taṃ jānamāno samaṇo garaheyyāti.
segments.mn103:15.6: Etaṃ panāvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’ti.
segments.mn103:15.7: Sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn103:15.8: ‘etaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’ti.
segments.mn103:16.1: “Athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha, so upasaṅkamitvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.mn103:16.2: ‘yaṃ no, āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppanno diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi, taṃ jānamāno samaṇo garaheyyā’ti.
segments.mn103:16.3: Sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn103:16.4: ‘yaṃ no, āvuso, amhākaṃ samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññamaññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppanno diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi taṃ jānamāno samaṇo garaheyyāti.
segments.mn103:16.5: Etaṃ panāvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’ti.
segments.mn103:16.6: Sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn103:16.7: ‘etaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ appahāya na nibbānaṃ sacchikareyyā’”ti.
segments.mn103:17.1: “Taṃ ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.mn103:17.2: ‘āyasmatā no ete bhikkhū akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpitā’ti?
segments.mn103:17.3: Sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn103:17.4: ‘idhāhaṃ, āvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ, tassa me bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi, tāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāsiṃ.
segments.mn103:17.5: Taṃ te bhikkhū dhammaṃ sutvā akusalā vuṭṭhahiṃsu, kusale patiṭṭhahiṃsū’ti.
segments.mn103:17.6: Evaṃ byākaramāno kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na ceva attānaṃ ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaroti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti.
segments.mn103:17.8: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Baliharaṇeti tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe bhūtānaṃ baliṃ āharanti, tasmā so baliharaṇanti vutto.
Itibhavābhavahetūti evaṃ imaṃ desanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nissāya tasmiṃ tasmiṃ bhave sukhaṃ vedissāmīti dhammaṃ desetīti kiṃ tumhākaṃ evaṃ hotīti attho.
Atthato ceva nānaṃ byañjanato cāti ettha “kāyova satipaṭṭhānaṃ vedanāva satipaṭṭhānan”ti vutte atthato nānaṃ hoti,“satipaṭṭhānā”ti vutte pana byañjanato nānaṃ nāma hoti.
Tadamināpīti taṃ tumhe imināpi kāraṇena jānāthāti atthañca byañjanañca samānetvā athassa ca aññathā gahitabhāvo byañjanassa ca micchā ropitabhāvo dassetabbo.
Yo dhammo yo vinayoti ettha atthañca byañjanañca viññāpanakāraṇameva dhammo ca vinayo ca.
Atthato hi kho sametīti satiyeva satipaṭṭhānanti gahitā.
Byañjanato nānanti kevalaṃ byañjanameva satipaṭṭhānoti vā satipaṭṭhānāti vā micchā ropetha.
Appamattakaṃ khoti suttantaṃ patvā byañjanaṃ appamattakaṃ nāma hoti.
Parittamattaṃ dhanitaṃ katvā ropitepi hi nibbutiṃ pattuṃ sakkā hoti.
Tatridaṃ vatthu – vijayārāmavihāravāsī kireko khīṇāsavatthero dvinnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ suttaṃ āharitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathento –
“samuddho samuddhoti, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano bhāsatī”ti dhanitaṃ katvā āha.

Āvuso, samuddhoti vuttepi samuddoti vuttepi mayaṃ loṇasāgarameva jānāma, tumhe pana no atthagavesakā, byañjanagavesakā, gacchatha mahāvihāre paguṇabyañjanānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike byañjanaṃ sodhāpethāti kammaṭṭhānaṃ akathetvāva uṭṭhāpesi.
So aparabhāge mahāvihāre bheriṃ paharāpetvā bhikkhusaṅghassa catūsu maggesu pañhaṃ kathetvāva parinibbuto.
Evaṃ suttantaṃ patvā byañjanaṃ appamattakaṃ nāma hoti.
Sāmaṇerapabbajjāpi hi ubhatosuddhito vaṭṭati, upasampadādikammānipi sithilādīnaṃ dhanitādikaraṇamatteneva kuppanti.
“Ahaṃ satimeva satipaṭṭhānaṃ vadāmi, ayaṃ ‘kāyo satipaṭṭhānan’ti vadatī”ti hi nesaṃ saññā hoti.
Ekacco hi puggalo “nalāṭe te sāsapamattā piḷakā”ti vutto “mayhaṃ nalāṭe sāsapamattaṃ piḷakaṃ passasi, attano nalāṭe tālapakkamattaṃ mahāgaṇḍaṃ na passasī”ti vadati.
Adaḷhadiṭṭhīti anādānadiṭṭhī suṃsumāraṃ hadaye pakkhipanto viya daḷhaṃ na gaṇhāti.

Suppaṭinissaggīti “kiṃ nāma ahaṃ āpanno, kadā āpanno”ti vā “tvaṃ āpanno, tava upajjhāyo āpanno”ti vā ekaṃ dve vāre vatvāpi “asukaṃ nāma asukadivase nāma, bhante, āpannattha, saṇikaṃ anussarathā”ti saritvā tāvadeva vissajjeti.

Sakkomīti evarūpo hi puggalo okāsaṃ kāretvā “āpattiṃ āpannattha, bhante”ti vutto “kadā kismiṃ vatthusmin”ti vatvā “asukadivase asukasmiṃ vatthusmin”ti vutte “na sarāmi, āvuso”ti vadati, tato “saṇikaṃ, bhante, sarathā”ti bahuṃ vatvā sārito saritvā vissajjeti.
Upekkhā nātimaññitabbāti upekkhā na atikkamitabbā, kattabbā janetabbāti attho.
Yo hi evarūpaṃ puggalaṃ ṭhitakaṃyeva passāvaṃ karontaṃ disvāpi “nanu, āvuso, nisīditabban”ti vadati, so upekkhaṃ atimaññati nāma.
Imehi kathitaṃ amūsaṃ antaraṃ paveseyya, tumhe imehi idañcidañca vuttāti amūhi kathitaṃ imesaṃ antaraṃ paveseyyāti attho.
Taṃ jānamāno samāno garaheyyāti taṃ satthā jānamāno samāno nindeyya amheti.
Evaṃ byākareyyāti mayā ete suddhante patiṭṭhāpitāti avatvā yena kāraṇena saññatti katā, tadeva dassento evaṃ byākareyya.
Na ceva attānantiādīsu “brahmalokappamāṇo hesa aggi uṭṭhāsi, ko etamaññatra mayā nibbāpetuṃ samattho”ti hi vadanto attānaṃ ukkaṃseti nāma.
“Ettakā janā vicaranti, okāso laddhuṃ na sakkā, ekopi ettakamattaṃ nibbāpetuṃ samattho nāma natthī”ti vadamāno paraṃ vambheti nāma.
Dhammo panettha sammāsambuddhassa byākaraṇaṃ, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññattikaraṇaṃ anudhammo, tadeva byākaroti nāma.
Na ca koci sahadhammikoti añño cassa koci sahetuko parehi vutto vādo vā anuvādo vā garahitabbabhāvaṃ āgacchanto nāma natthi.
Vuddhiattho hi ayaṃ a-kāro,“saṃvarāsaṃvaro, phalāphalan”tiādīsu viya, tasmā bhavābhavahetūti khuddakassa mahantassa vā bhavassa hetu, taṃ paccāsīsamānoti attho.
Lokuttarabodhipakkhiyadhamme uddissa puthujjanānaṃ vivādo sambhavatīti āha –
Lokiyāpi hi bodhipakkhiyadhammā lokuttaradhammādhigamassa āsannakāraṇattā visesakāraṇanti yāva aññehi lokiyadhammehi abhivisiṭṭhoti katvā,“imesu sattatiṃsabodhipakkhiyadhammesū”ti avisesena vuttaṃ.
Atthato nānaṃ hotīti atthato bhedo hoti bodhipakkhiyadhammānaṃ samadhigatattā.
Na hi kāyādayo bhāvetabbā, satiyeva pana bhāvetabbāti.
Tattha samānetvāti suttantarato samānetvā, suttantarapadehi ca samānetvā.
Atthañca byañjanañca viññāpanakāraṇamevāti aviparītatthassa saddassa ca bujjhanahetutāya.
Idha dhammavinayaṭṭhāne satiyeva satipaṭṭhānanti gahitā, atthato sameti nāma yāthāvato atthassa gahitattā.
Asabhāvaniruttibhāvato byañjanato nānattanti taṃ liṅgabhedena vacanabhedena ca dassento,“satipaṭṭhānoti vā satipaṭṭhānāti vā micchā ropethā”ti āha.
Appamattakanti aṇumattaṃ sallahukaṃ, na garutaraṃ adhanitaṃ katvā vattabbampi dhanitaṃ ghosavantaṃ katvā ropite vuttadosābhāvatoti tenāha –
Byañjanassa micchāropanaṃ na visesantarāyakaraṃ hotīti ñāpanatthaṃ, catusu maggesu pañhaṃ kathetvāva parinibbuto.
Yāvatā nesaṃ vacanaṃ atthato ceva sameti byañjanato cāti adhippāyo.
Saññāya vivādoti kiñcāpi sameti atthato ceva byañjanato ca, saññā pana nesaṃ avisuddhā, tāya saññāya vasena vivādo jātoti dassento “ahan”tiādimāha.
Ahaṃ satipaṭṭhānanti vadāmi, ayaṃ satipaṭṭhānoti vadatīti evaṃ tesaṃ ñāṇaṃ hotīti imamatthaṃ,“eseva nayo”ti iminā atidisati.
Na codanatthāya vegāyitabbanti sīghaṃ sīghaṃ na codanā kātabbāti attho.
Tasmāti yasmā ekacco kodhanabhāvena evaṃ paṭipphari, tasmā.
Dve vāre vatvāpi visajjetīti suppaṭinissaggī evaṃ pageva coditamatte vissajjeti ceti adhippāyo.
Evarūpoti sahasā avissajjentena codakassa vihesāvādo hutvāpi akkodhanādisabhāvo.
Upekkhāti sakena kammena paññāyissatīti tasmiṃ puggale ajjhupekkhaṇā.
Dhammoti sambuddhassa tassa tathā pavattaṃ byākaraṇaṃ yathā vivādāpannā saññattiṃ gacchanti.
Tadeva byākaraṇaṃ anudhammoti bhikkhunā vuccamāno anupavatto dhammo.
Assāti vuttanayena paṭipannabhikkhuno, tassa paṭipatti na kenaci garahaṇīyā hotīti attho.
